245: def controller_admitted_envelope(startup, primitives, read_set, worker, choice, usage, generation, child_source_sha256):
 246:     """Construct an authenticated admitted-selection envelope carrying exact retained bindings."""
 247:     _require(choice in MODEL_MEMBERS, "unsupported_admitted_choice")
 248:     expected_members = MODEL_MEMBERS[choice]
 249:     _require(len(read_set.members) == len(read_set.identities) == len(worker.child_read_handles) == len(expected_members),
 250:              "exact_admitted_readset_membership")
 251:     _require(startup.selected.choice == choice, "startup_choice_mismatch")
 252:     assets_by_name = {asset.name: asset for asset in startup.selected.assets}
 253:     _require(set(assets_by_name) == set(expected_members), "startup_assets_mismatch_model_spec")
 254:     rows = []
 255:     for index, name in enumerate(expected_members):
 256:         handle = read_set.members[index]
 257:         expected_identity = read_set.identities[index]
 258:         primitives._owned(handle)
 259:         _require(primitives.identity(handle) == expected_identity, "parent_guard_identity_changed")
 260:         asset = assets_by_name[name]
 261:         row = {
 262:             "name": name,
 263:             "handle": worker.child_read_handles[index],
 264:             "size": asset.size,
 265:             "sha256": asset.sha256,
 266:             "identity": _identity_row(expected_identity),
 267:         }
 268:         rows.append(row)
 269:     snapshot_identity = _identity_row(startup.admission.directory_identity)
 270:     payload = {
 271:         "schema": ADMITTED_FORMAT,
 272:         "release_manifest_sha256": startup.release.manifest_approval.manifest_sha256,
 273:         "selection": {
 274:             "choice": choice,
 275:             "repository": startup.selected.repo,
 276:             "revision": startup.selected.revision,
 277:         },
 278:         "members": rows,
 279:         "profile": {
 280:             "profile_id": startup.policy.profile_id,
 281:             "device": startup.policy.device,
 282:             "compute_type": startup.policy.compute_type,
 283:             "whisperx_fixed_vad_contract": startup.policy.whisperx_fixed_vad_contract,
 284:             "capture_vad_contract": startup.policy.capture_vad_contract,
 285:             "usage": usage,
 286:         },
 287:         "snapshot": {
 288:             "snapshot_path": startup.admission.snapshot,
 289:             "directory_identity": snapshot_identity,
 290:         },
 291:         "channel_binding": {
 292:             "generation_hex": generation,
 293:             "child_source_sha256": child_source_sha256,
 294:             "process_creation_time": worker.creation_time,
 295:         },
 296:     }
 297:     envelope_sha = admitted_envelope_digest(payload)
 298:     _require(envelope_sha != startup.release.manifest_approval.manifest_sha256,
 299:              "envelope_digest_must_differ_from_manifest_digest")
 300:     validate_admitted_envelope(payload, choice, worker.child_control_handle, envelope_sha)
 301:     return payload

 304: def validate_admitted_envelope(payload, choice, control_value, expected_envelope_sha256, channel_binding=None):
 305:     """Validate authenticated admitted envelope shape, membership, handles and identities."""
 306:     _require(type(payload) is dict and set(payload) == {
 307:         "schema", "release_manifest_sha256", "selection", "members", "profile", "snapshot", "channel_binding"
 308:     }, "admitted_envelope_shape")
 309:     _require(payload["schema"] == ADMITTED_FORMAT, "admitted_envelope_schema")
 310:     _require(type(expected_envelope_sha256) is str and len(expected_envelope_sha256) == 64
 311:              and admitted_envelope_digest(payload) == expected_envelope_sha256,
 312:              "authenticated_admitted_envelope_binding")
 313:     _require(payload["release_manifest_sha256"] != expected_envelope_sha256,
 314:              "envelope_digest_must_differ_from_manifest_digest")
 315:     _require(type(choice) is str and choice in MODEL_MEMBERS, "unsupported_admitted_choice")
 316:     selection = payload["selection"]
 317:     _require(type(selection) is dict and set(selection) == {"choice", "repository", "revision"}
 318:              and selection["choice"] == choice, "admitted_selection_mismatch")
 319:     expected_members = MODEL_MEMBERS[choice]
 320:     rows = payload["members"]
 321:     _require(type(rows) is list and len(rows) == len(expected_members),
 322:              "admitted_envelope_member_count_mismatch")
 323:     _require(type(control_value) is int and 0 < control_value < (1 << 64) - 1, "fixed_control_handle")
 324:     seen_handles = set()
 325:     seen_identities = set()
 326:     validated = []
 327:     for index, expected_name in enumerate(expected_members):
 328:         row = rows[index]
 329:         _require(type(row) is dict and set(row) == {"name", "handle", "size", "sha256", "identity"}, "member_shape")
 330:         name, handle_val, size, sha256_val, ident = (
 331:             row["name"], row["handle"], row["size"], row["sha256"], row["identity"]
 332:         )
 333:         _require(name == expected_name, "member_order_and_name_mismatch")
 334:         _require(type(handle_val) is int and 0 < handle_val < (1 << 64) - 1 and handle_val != control_value,
 335:                  "invalid_inherited_member_handle")
 336:         _require(handle_val not in seen_handles, "aliased_inherited_member_handles_refused")
 337:         seen_handles.add(handle_val)
 338:         _require(type(size) is int and size > 0, "positive_asset_size_required")
 339:         _require(type(sha256_val) is str and len(sha256_val) == 64 and all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in sha256_val),
 340:                  "asset_sha256_format")
 341:         _require(type(ident) is dict and set(ident) == {"final_path", "volume_serial", "file_id", "size", "links", "directory"},
 342:                  "complete_file_identity_shape")
 343:         _require(ident["size"] == size and ident["links"] == 1 and ident["directory"] is False, "member_file_shape")
 344:         file_key = (ident["volume_serial"], ident["file_id"])
 345:         _require(file_key not in seen_identities, "aliased_physical_member_identities_refused")
 346:         seen_identities.add(file_key)
 347:         file_id_bytes = bytes.fromhex(ident["file_id"]) if isinstance(ident["file_id"], str) else ident["file_id"]
 348:         expected_fid = FileIdentity(ident["final_path"], ident["volume_serial"], file_id_bytes,
 349:                                     ident["size"], ident["links"], ident["directory"])
 350:         validated.append({"name": name, "handle": handle_val, "size": size, "sha256": sha256_val, "identity": expected_fid})
 351:     profile = payload["profile"]
 352:     _require(type(profile) is dict and set(profile) == {
 353:         "profile_id", "device", "compute_type", "whisperx_fixed_vad_contract", "capture_vad_contract", "usage"
 354:     }, "admitted_profile_shape")
 355:     _require(profile["device"] == "cpu" and profile["compute_type"] in ("int8", "float32"), "qualified_cpu_profile_required")
 356:     snapshot = payload["snapshot"]
 357:     _require(type(snapshot) is dict and set(snapshot) == {"snapshot_path", "directory_identity"}, "admitted_snapshot_shape")
 358:     if channel_binding is not None:
 359:         cb = payload["channel_binding"]
 360:         _require(type(cb) is dict and set(cb) == {"generation_hex", "child_source_sha256", "process_creation_time"},
 361:                  "admitted_channel_binding_shape")
 362:         _require(cb["generation_hex"] == channel_binding.generation_hex
 363:                  and cb["child_source_sha256"] == channel_binding.bootstrap_source_sha256
 364:                  and cb["process_creation_time"] == channel_binding.process_creation_time,
 365:                  "admitted_channel_binding_mismatch")
 366:     return tuple(validated)

 369: class AdmittedReadSetAdoption:
 370:     """Worker-local adoption for verified admitted-model members."""
 371: 
 372:     def __init__(self, primitives):
 373:         self.primitives = primitives
 374:         self.read_set = None
 375:         self.assets = None
 376:         self.namespace = None
 377:         self.inheritance_cleared = 0
 378:         self.identities_checked = 0
 379:         self.observed_identities = []
 380:         self.materialization_started = False
 381:         self.status = "new"
 382:         self.envelope = None
 383:         self.envelope_sha256 = None
 384:         self.payload_budget = 0
 385: 
 386:     def adopt_admitted(self, authenticated_payload, choice, control_value, expected_envelope_sha256, channel_binding=None):
 387:         _require(self.status == "new" and self.read_set is None, "single_adoption_attempt")
 388:         self.status = "validating"
 389:         try:
 390:             validated_rows = validate_admitted_envelope(
 391:                 authenticated_payload, choice, control_value, expected_envelope_sha256, channel_binding
 392:             )
 393:             _require(not any(not handle.closed and handle.value in {row["handle"] for row in validated_rows}
 394:                              for handle in self.primitives.handles), "inherited_handle_already_owned")
 395:             read_set = ReadSet()
 396:             self.read_set = read_set
 397:             self.primitives.read_sets.append(read_set)
 398:             # Retain all adopted handles before querying flags or identity.
 399:             for row in validated_rows:
 400:                 read_set.members.append(self.primitives._retain(row["handle"], "adopted-admitted-member"))
 401:             ffi = self.primitives.api.ffi
 402:             for handle in read_set.members:
 403:                 flags = ffi.c_uint32()
 404:                 self.primitives.api.checked("GetHandleInformation", self.primitives._owned(handle), ffi.byref(flags))
 405:                 _require(flags.value == 1, "exact_inherited_handle_flag_required")
 406:                 self.primitives.api.checked("SetHandleInformation", self.primitives._owned(handle), 1, 0)
 407:                 self.primitives.api.checked("GetHandleInformation", self.primitives._owned(handle), ffi.byref(flags))
 408:                 _require(flags.value == 0, "inherited_flag_not_cleared")
 409:                 self.inheritance_cleared += 1
 410:             for handle, row in zip(read_set.members, validated_rows):
 411:                 actual = self.primitives.identity(handle)
 412:                 self.identities_checked += 1
 413:                 self.observed_identities.append(_identity_row(actual))
 414:                 _require(actual == row["identity"], "inherited_file_identity_mismatch")
 415:                 read_set.identities.append(actual)
 416:             self.assets = tuple(BufferAsset(row["name"], row["size"], row["sha256"], handle)
 417:                                 for handle, row in zip(read_set.members, validated_rows))
 418:             self.payload_budget = sum(asset.size for asset in self.assets)
 419:             self.envelope = authenticated_payload
 420:             self.envelope_sha256 = expected_envelope_sha256
 421:             self.status = "adopted"
 422:             return self
 423:         except BaseException:
 424:             self.status = "refused"
 425:             if self.read_set is not None:
 426:                 self.read_set.unconfirmed = True
 427:             raise
 428: 
 429:     def materialize_admitted(self):
 430:         _require(self.status == "adopted" and not self.materialization_started, "adoption_before_readback")
 431:         self.materialization_started = True
 432:         # Retain the namespace attempt before reading.
 433:         self.namespace = PinnedBufferNamespace(self.primitives, self.read_set, self.assets, self.payload_budget)
 434:         try:
 435:             self.namespace.materialize()
 436:             self.status = "materialized"
 437:             return {
 438:                 "namespace_sha256": self.namespace.namespace_sha256,
 439:                 "payload_bytes": self.payload_budget,
 440:                 "members": [{"name": asset.name, "bytes": asset.size, "sha256": asset.sha256}
 441:                             for asset in self.assets]
 442:             }
 443:         except BaseException:
 444:             self.status = "refused"
 445:             self.read_set.unconfirmed = True
 446:             raise
 447: 
 448:     def release_unread(self):
 449:         """Release unread adoption upon early cancel without materializing buffers."""
 450:         _require(self.status == "adopted" and not self.materialization_started, "unread_cancel_only")
 451:         if self.read_set is not None:
 452:             for handle in self.read_set.members:
 453:                 if not handle.closed:
 454:                     self.primitives._close(handle)
 455:             self.read_set.released = True
 456:         self.status = "cancelled"
 457:         return True
 458: 
 459:     def release_after_reads(self):
 460:         _require(self.status == "materialized" and self.read_set is not None and not self.read_set.unconfirmed,
 461:                  "only_successful_readback_can_release")
 462:         result = self.primitives.release_read_set(self.read_set)
 463:         _require(result is True and self.read_set.released, "child_read_guard_release_unconfirmed")
 464:         self.status = "released"
 465:         return True
 466: 
 467:     def receipt(self):
 468:         return {
 469:             "status": self.status,
 470:             "owned_members": len(self.read_set.members) if self.read_set else 0,
 471:             "inheritance_cleared": self.inheritance_cleared,
 472:             "identities_checked": self.identities_checked,
 473:             "observed_identities": list(self.observed_identities),
 474:             "materialization_started": self.materialization_started,
 475:             "read_set_unconfirmed": self.read_set.unconfirmed if self.read_set else None,
 476:             "read_set_released": self.read_set.released if self.read_set else False,
 477:             "handles_closed": [handle.closed for handle in self.read_set.members] if self.read_set else [],
 478:             "complete_native_namespace_protection": False,
 479:             "model_calls": 0,
 480:         }
 481: 
 482: 
 483: def expected_admitted_adoption_response(adoption):
 484:     return {
 485:         "status": adoption.status,
 486:         "owned_members": len(adoption.read_set.members),
 487:         "inheritance_cleared": adoption.inheritance_cleared,
 488:         "identities_checked": adoption.identities_checked,
 489:         "materialization_started": adoption.materialization_started,
 490:     }
